title: Day Planner
summary: Full stack daily planner with accounts, tasks and push reminders.
description: Full stack app: a React and TypeScript frontend, a Node.js API with Hono, PostgreSQL with Drizzle, login with JWT, password reset by email, and reminders sent as web push notifications. Deployed on Render and Neon.

title: Projects Hub
summary: Projects gallery with search and tech filters, tested and deployed automatically.
description: Built with React and TypeScript. Search and tech filters that can be shared as a link, 33 tests with Vitest and React Testing Library, and a GitHub Actions pipeline that tests and deploys it.

title: Study Night Flashcards
summary: Flashcards app with end-to-end and unit tests and an automated pipeline.
description: A flashcards app I tested and prepared for production: Cypress end-to-end tests, Mocha unit tests, ESLint, a Parcel build, and a GitHub Actions pipeline that publishes the site only when all tests pass.

title: 3D Platformer PC Game
summary: Game design and interactive worldbuilding project presented in Figma.
description: Game design project related to immersive and interactive media work, presented as a Figma case study.

title: Neurolitics UI/UX Design
summary: UI/UX design project presented as a Figma case study.
description: Product design work focused on interface design, layout structure, and user-centered thinking, presented in Figma.
